meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin in India, the right serum depends on whether you are dealing with **active breakouts/pimples** or mostly **post-acne dark spots and scars**.

Several science-backed, effective options are available under ₹700 from trusted Indian skincare brands:

---

### 1. For Active Acne, Clogged Pores, and Blackheads

*If you frequently get whiteheads, blackheads, or painful pimples, look for **Salicylic Acid (BHA)**, which penetrates deep into pores to dissolve oil and debris.*[www.healthshots.com](https://www.healthshots.com/beauty/skin-care/best-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2025/#:~:text=This%20serum%20for%20acne-prone%20skin%20dives%20deep,clears%20blackheads.%20Oil-control%20and%20exfoliation%20in%20one.)

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum[www.youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1oqPNdetGXc#:~:text=Amazon%20%26%20Flipkart%3A-%20Some%20Amazon%20Product%20not,the%20Vitamin%20C%20Face%20Serum%20for%20you.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹549 (often lower during sales)
  * **Why it works:** Contains 2% Salicylic Acid combined with Centella Water to soothe inflammation. It is fragrance-free, controls excess sebum, and clears out acne congestion cleanly.
* **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum[www.healthshots.com](https://www.healthshots.com/beauty/skin-care/best-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2025/#:~:text=Using%20a%20serum%20with%20a%20blend%20of,future%20breakouts%20without%20drying%20out%20your%20skin.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599
  * **Why it works:** A potent formula that targets blackheads, whiteheads, and active breakouts.[www.healthshots.com](https://www.healthshots.com/beauty/skin-care/best-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2025/#:~:text=This%20serum%20for%20acne-prone%20skin%20dives%20deep,clears%20blackheads.%20Oil-control%20and%20exfoliation%20in%20one.) It works quickly on acne, though beginners should introduce it slowly (2–3 times a week) to avoid initial dryness.[www.healthshots.com](https://www.healthshots.com/beauty/skin-care/best-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2025/#:~:text=This%20dual-action%20face%20serum%20for%20acne-prone%20skin,avoid%3A%20May%20cause%20dryness%20or%20peeling%20initially.)

---

### 2. For Oil Control, Redness, and Mild Texture Issues

*If your skin is oily, easily irritated, and prone to general congestion, **Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)** is ideal.*

* **Deconstruct Oil Control Serum (3% Niacinamide + 2% Salicylic Acid)[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=H2-%20Choosing%20the%20Best%20Face%20Serum%20in,easily%2C%20leaving%20your%20skin%20clear%20and%20calm.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=Oil%20Control%20Serum%20with%203%25%20Niacinamide%20%26,-%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20%2B%200.3%25%20Alpha%20Arbutin.)
  * **Why it works:** This is a fantastic multi-tasker for acne-prone skin.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=With%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20to%20exfoliate%20and,pigmentation%2C%20acne%20marks%2C%20and%20uneven%20skin%20tone.) It pairs salicylic acid to clear pores with niacinamide to control sebum production and calm redness without stripping the skin.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=H2-%20Choosing%20the%20Best%20Face%20Serum%20in,easily%2C%20leaving%20your%20skin%20clear%20and%20calm.)
* **Dr. Sheth's Centella & 10% Niacinamide Face Serum[www.healthshots.com](https://www.healthshots.com/beauty/skin-care/best-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2025/#:~:text=Some%20users%20report%20clearer%20skin%20in%202-3,Indian%20skin%20prone%20to%20sensitivity%20and%20pigmentation.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹599 (frequently discounted)
  * **Why it works:** Formulated specifically for Indian skin, it combines a high concentration of niacinamide for oil regulation with Centella Asiatica (Cica), which is exceptionally calming for inflamed, angry acne.[www.healthshots.com](https://www.healthshots.com/beauty/skin-care/best-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2025/#:~:text=Some%20users%20report%20clearer%20skin%20in%202-3,Indian%20skin%20prone%20to%20sensitivity%20and%20pigmentation.)

---

### 3. For Post-Acne Marks and Dark Spots

*If your active breakouts have cleared up but you are left with stubborn brown or red marks (hyperpigmentation), choose a brightening serum.*

* **Minimalist 5% Niacinamide Serum**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹545
  * **Why it works:** Safe, gentle, and effective at fading acne scars while repairing the skin barrier.
* **Deconstruct Dark Spot Clearing Serum (5% Niacinamide + 2% Alpha Arbutin)[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=Dark%20Spot%20Clearing%20Serum%20with%20Liposomal%20Technology,Boost%20Skin%20Radiance%20and%20Brightness.%20%E2%80%9325%25%20off.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹524[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=Dark%20Spot%20Clearing%20Serum%20with%20Liposomal%20Technology,Boost%20Skin%20Radiance%20and%20Brightness.%20%E2%80%9325%25%20off.)
  * **Why it works:** Alpha Arbutin is a powerhouse ingredient for tackling pigmentation left behind by pimples, working alongside niacinamide to even out skin tone.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/face-serums#:~:text=It's%20water-based%2C%20lightweight%20texture%20gets%20absorbed%20easily%2C,as%20well%20as%20sensitive%20and%20combination%20skin.)

---

### Quick Buying Tips:

1.  **Patch Test:** Always test a new serum on your inner elbow or jawline for 24 hours before applying it all over your face.
2.  **Sunscreen is Non-Negotiable:** Acne serums (especially chemical exfoliants like Salicylic Acid) make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Always follow up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day.

Which specific skin concern would you like to target first—active breakouts or acne scars?
